Maya (CS): Drafting a compact customer-facing runbook for day0->day7 onboarding: caching, batching, streaming, renewal signals. Need quick review.

Ravi (Eng): Looks good. Add a safe-default snippet so CSMs can paste into onboarding docs.

Maya (CS): Safe defaults: prefetch.top_k=5, prefetch.ttl_s=300, batch.size=8, batch.max_latency_ms=60, streaming.enabled=true for conversational flows, fallback.variant=small if p95>400ms. Also flag trial_usage<5 as low-engagement.

Lina (CS): Add day-by-day cadence: Day0 test API key + curl, Day1 enable prefetch & batch, Day3 verify streaming UX, Day5 send 2-question NPS + feedback link, Day7 run health check and escalate if low usage.

Noah (SRE): Add infra hints: circuit_breaker.error_rate=0.05, window_s=60, retry_backoff=exp(200ms,2s). Limit initial client concurrency ~50 RPS. Ask customers to forward telemetry: request_id, latency_ms, model_variant, cache_status.

Maya (CS): Troubleshooting notes to include: no prefetch hits -> check prefix tokenization & sample set; high tail latency -> reduce batch.size or enable streaming; low engagement -> validate session sampling and NPS prompt delivery.

Ravi (Eng): Small helpful check customers can run: curl POST /v1/prefetch with a sample prefix; expect HTTP200 and header x-prefetch-cache: hit. Add example JSON for renewal event: {customer_id, week_calls, nps_score, reasons}.

Lina (CS): Escalation play: if NPS<=3 AND week_calls<10 -> CSM + SE + SRE triage within 48h. Include short email template for Day5 feedback.

oncall-bot: Reminder: if streaming.enabled=true in prod, post a change note to streaming-features channel; automated follow-up in 24h.

Maya (CS): I'll convert this into a one-pager and push to the enablement repo, ping @here once done. Thanks for the quick checks!
